summary: GeoPark filed a 6-K announcing effectiveness of the 25-year Bare Block CPP in Venezuela and completion of its acquisition of the remaining 95% of CPP Holdco from Grupo Gilinski, following an initial 5% stake. Consideration was entirely equity: 42,135,872 new common shares issued to Panamerican Energy Holdings, with no cash paid. Grupo Gilinski becomes controlling shareholder at roughly 56.3%, potentially 58.4% via up to 5,421,589 milestone shares, deadline extended to December 1, 2026. A tender offer is required within 90 days. Watch governance overhang, minority protections and milestone dilution.
